name: playwright-framework
description: Enterprise Playwright TypeScript automation framework for sauceDemo.com

scripts.test:dev: cross-env TEST_ENV=dev npx playwright test tests/sauceDemo.spec.ts --headed
scripts.test:qa: cross-env TEST_ENV=qa npx playwright test tests/sauceDemo.spec.ts --headed
scripts.test:prod: cross-env TEST_ENV=prod npx playwright test tests/sauceDemo.spec.ts --headed
scripts.test:ci: cross-env TEST_ENV=qa CI=true npx playwright test --project=chromium
